_comment: The registry of everywhere this project can look, and every document it has cited.
Canonical and machine-readable: tools/research.mjs validates the search log against
it and regenerates docs/sources.md from it. Add a source here the moment it is
discovered — a venue that is searched but never registered is one the next pass
kind:   archive | index | tree | obituary | cemetery | record | family
access: open | login | paywall | offline | mixed
'login' means an account is needed; 'offline' means a physical visit or a
written request. Both are facts about how to reach it, not about its value.
confidence (record kinds only): doc | sup | fam, matching the person records.

sources.title: Rijksarchief AGATHA — Belgian State Archives search robot
sources.covers: Belgian civil registers and parish registers by commune and year, with scans. The primary route for 19th-century Belgian acts.
sources.note: Post-1900 Oostende civil registers are NOT here — they are held at the Stadsarchief Oostende. Marriage acts are the richest single record: they name both spouses' parents.

sources.title: Rijksarchief search portal
sources.covers: Scanned civil registers by commune and year; the sibling portal to AGATHA.

sources.title: FamilySearch
sources.covers: "Belgium, West Flanders, Civil Registration, 1582-1950" and "Belgium, East Flanders, Church and Civil Registration, 1541-1920" — deeper indexes than AGATHA or Ancestry, with act images.
sources.note: Broke the Édouard Dekeyser wall that AGATHA and Ancestry could not. Try it before concluding a Belgian act is unindexed.

sources.title: Geneanet — member trees and record index
sources.covers: Member-submitted trees plus an indexed record collection. The member trees are the main lever for 19th-century frontiers.

sources.title: Ancestry
sources.covers: West-Vlaanderen and Brabant civil-registration indexes, searchable province-wide.

sources.title: MyHeritage
sources.covers: Indexed Belgian civil registration.
sources.note: Login-walled in past passes; results were not reachable.

sources.title: Vrijwilligers RAB — marriage and death indexes
sources.covers: Volunteer transcriptions of West-Flemish marriage and death records.
sources.note: Corrected Henricus Josephus Bostin's birth and death (Koekelare 1801 / Varsenare 1867).

sources.title: Stadsarchief Oostende
sources.covers: Oostende civil registers after 1900 — not in AGATHA and not digitised.
sources.note: Holds the two documents that would name Édouard Dekeyser's parents from Oostende's own registers: the 4 May 1901 marriage act and the 8 Sep 1951 death act. Death acts open after 50 years, so the 1951 one is public and is the cleanest ask.

sources.title: inmemoriam.be (Mediahuis)
sources.covers: Digitised Belgian obituary notices.
sources.note: Coverage gap: coastal and Brabant papers are poorly represented, so a post-2000 death on the coast may simply be absent.

sources.title: ingedachten.be / DELA
sources.covers: Funeral-home obituary notices.

sources.title: Uitvaart Oostende
sources.covers: Oostende funeral notices.

sources.title: jammart.be — doodsprentjes collection
sources.covers: Scanned memorial cards (bidprentjes), ~100,000 of them.
sources.note: Memorial cards name parents and children and sit outside the civil-registration privacy rule, which makes them the key to 20th-century walls. Beware regional false positives — match on place, not surname.

sources.covers: Belgian gravestone and cemetery records.

sources.title: Édouard Dekeyser's 1946 Oostende remarriage act
sources.collection: FamilySearch — Belgium, West Flanders, Civil Registration, 1582-1950 (Arr. Brugge, Burgerlijke Stand 1921-1950: Oostende, Huwelijkscertificaten 1946, akte nr. 81)
sources.proves: Édouard Dekeyser's parents = Desiderius De Keyser × Maria Theresia Van den Broeck; birthplace Hamme (Oost-Vlaanderen), b. 12 Nov 1876; first marriage to Louisa Maria Bocklandt ended in divorce (~1923, Rechtbank van eersten aanleg Brugge); remarried Leontine Schreel in Oostende 9 May 1946.
sources.note: The wall-breaker. Read directly from the act image.

sources.title: Jérôme Dekeyser's 1897 Oostende birth act (legitimization note)
sources.collection: Rijksarchief AGATHA — Burgerlijke stand geboorteakten Oostende 1897, akte nr. 585
sources.proves: Édouard × Louise married 4 May 1901 — the marginal note "Gewettigd 4 5 1901" legitimizes Jérôme (b. 14 Jun 1897) and Gustavus (b. 1899).

sources.title: Louise Bocklandt's ancestry (Bocklandt / Van Bergen, to 1768)
sources.proves: Louise Bocklandt (b. 31 Dec 1877 Hamme O-Vl) → Eduardus Bocklandt (1839) × Maria Louisa Van Bergen (1842-1888) → Antonius Dominicus Bocklandt (1805-1883) × Isabella Livia Ichau (1803-1870) → Daniel Bocklandt (1768-1837) × Philippa Van Puyenbroeck (1778-1820); and Van Bergen: Joannes Franciscus Van Bergen (1815-1898) × Ida Vermandel (1825-1865).
sources.note: sup for the ancestors, doc for Louise's own parents, which are independently on her AGATHA record.

sources.title: Desiderius De Keyser × Maria Theresia Van den Broeck in Oost-Vlaanderen
sources.collection: FamilySearch — Belgium, East Flanders, Church and Civil Registration, 1541-1920
sources.proves: The couple were a Hamme (O-Vl) family; further children incl. Augustinus (†1883 infant), Frederiens Carolus, Leontinus Josephus.
sources.note: FRONTIER, unconfirmed: a "Desiderius de Keyser b. 27 May 1832, O-Vl, parents Arnoldus de Keyser × Angelina Sophia van Kerkhove" exists but is NOT yet linked to our Desiderius. Do not graft until an act ties him to Van den Broeck.

sources.title: Zaventem Van Craenenbroeck trunk (to the 1830s)
sources.proves: Amandus Franciscus Van Craenenbroeck (1835-1914) × Paulina Mommaerts (1838-1909) → Antonius Josephus (1872-1936) × Anna Maria Meeus (1877-1957) → children b. 1902-1918 (Amandus, Paul Gustaaf, Melania, Arthur, Maurice, Bertha).
sources.note: Anna Van Craenenbroeck's specific parent among those children is NOT documented. Strong lead, not a link — it is deliberately not grafted.

sources.title: Family testimony — Cosette De Keyser
sources.proves: Jerome Dekeyser ❦ Léonie Paelinck are Roland's grandparents, which ruled out the earlier Gustaaf Audomarus reading.

sources.title: Marcel Bundervoet's memorial card (Uitvaartcentrum Raes, Oostende)
sources.proves: Marcel Henri Bundervoet's full name and his Bostyn parentage.
